panels.description: Row count in infra_ai.inference_events by source. Proves TraceForge's agent-benchmark-runner dual-write (pkg/lensai, source=benchmark_run) lands in the same table as LensAI's native inference events (source=inference), not a second table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  source,
  count() AS events
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, source
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Events by source — inference vs benchmark_run

panels.description: cost_usd summed per tenant, split by source. benchmark_run rows are always 0 by design (pkg/lensai.ToEvent leaves CostUSD at 0.0 so batch cost isn't double-counted against the per-repetition ClickHouse benchmark_runs table) — this panel proves that, rather than a live cost comparison.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time,
  tenant_id,
  source,
  sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, tenant_id, source
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost per hour by tenant, split by source

panels.description: P99 latency_ms by source. benchmark_run's latency_ms is the batch's wall-clock Duration (see pkg/lensai.BatchParams), not a single inference call, so this panel compares distributions rather than claiming they're the same unit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  source,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99_ms
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, source
ORDER BY time

panels.title: P99 latency by source

panels.description: Most recent benchmark batches. request_id carries pkg/lensai.BatchParams.BatchID (join key back to this batch) and trace_id carries BatchParams.TaskID (join key to the task YAML) — see pkg/lensai.ToEvent. Cross-reference batch_id against agent-benchmark-runner's own benchmark_runs table (pkg/store) for per-repetition detail this row doesn't carry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp,
  tenant_id,
  request_id AS batch_id,
  trace_id AS task_id,
  model_id AS agent_name,
  status
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE source = 'benchmark_run'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent benchmark batches (source = benchmark_run)

panels.description: 1h rollup of model-quality-scorer's normalized_score (0-1, score/100 — comparable across rubrics with different weight distributions) per model_id x task_type, per pkg/rollup.Query(Window1h). sample_count below 30 (pkg/rollup.MinSamplesForConfidence, see model-quality-scorer/NOISE-FLOOR.md) is the statistical noise floor — a bucket below it is flagged low-confidence rather than shown at the same weight as a fully-sampled hour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(scored_at) AS window,
  model_id,
  task_type,
  count() AS sample_count,
  avg(normalized_score) AS avg_normalized_score,
  stddevPop(normalized_score) AS stddev_normalized_score
FROM infra_ai.quality_scores
WHERE $__timeFilter(scored_at)
GROUP BY window, model_id, task_type
ORDER BY window DESC

panels.title: Model quality — 1h rollup, normalized score (sample_count < 30 = low confidence)
